key: TAKA: There should be stairs here.
en: TAKA: There should be stairs here.
ja: タカ: ここには　階段が　あったはずです。

key: I guess they've flattened out to this slide to keep others out again.
en: I guess they've flattened out to this slide to keep others out again.
ja: また　他人を　締め出すために　滑り台に　ならしちゃったんでしょうね。

key: ..."Again"?
en: ..."Again"?

key: Hmm...
en: Hmm...
ja: うーん……

key: \PN, can we look around some more?
en: \PN, can we look around some more?
ja: \PN　もう少し　あたりを　見て回っても　いいですか?

key: There should definitely be a way to get past here.
en: There should definitely be a way to get past here.
ja: ここを　抜ける方法が　絶対　あるはずです。

key: There's a button below the statue of Arceus.
en: There's a button below the statue of Arceus.
ja: アルセウスの像の下に　ボタンが　ある。

key: Press it?
en: Press it?
ja: 押しますか?

key: ...But nothing happened.
en: ...But nothing happened.
ja: ……でも　何も　起こらなかった。

key: TAKA: There should be some kind of button on this statue...
en: TAKA: There should be some kind of button on this statue...
ja: タカ: この像には　何かボタンが　あるはずです……

key: There it is! It should be the key to moving forward.
en: There it is! It should be the key to moving forward.
ja: ありました! これが　先に進む　カギの　はずです。

key: Go ahead and press it, \PN.
en: Go ahead and press it, \PN.
ja: 押してください\PN。

key: TAKA: ...Nothing?
en: TAKA: ...Nothing?
ja: タカ: ……何も　ない?

key: I guess we have to hit the second one too.
en: I guess we have to hit the second one too.
ja: 二つ目も　押さなきゃ　いけないみたいですね。

key: I vaguely recall doing this before... with my father.
en: I vaguely recall doing this before... with my father.
ja: 前にも　これを　やった気が　します……　父と一緒に。

key: TAKA: Huh? I guess you can't be too safe, but I remember it being fine before...
en: TAKA: Huh? I guess you can't be too safe, but I remember it being fine before...
ja: タカ: あれ? 慎重に　越したことは　ないですけど　前は　平気だった気が　しますが……

key: The button is shoved firmly into the statue already.
en: The button is shoved firmly into the statue already.
ja: ボタンは　すでに　像に　しっかり　押しこまれている。

key: TAKA: This statue's already activated. I think we can move on.
en: TAKA: This statue's already activated. I think we can move on.
ja: タカ: この像は　もう　作動済みです。先に　進めると　思います。

key: TAKA: There'll be a button here...
en: TAKA: There'll be a button here...
ja: タカ: ここにも　ボタンが　あるはずです……

key: Yeah, go ahead and press it.
en: Yeah, go ahead and press it.
ja: ええ　押してください。

key: Then we can keep going.
en: Then we can keep going.
ja: それで　先に　進めます。

key: TAKA: Wait...
en: TAKA: Wait...
ja: タカ: 待って……

key: I think I know this place.
en: I think I know this place.
ja: ここ　見覚えが　あります。

key: \PN, let's get a closer look.
en: \PN, let's get a closer look.
ja: \PN　もっと　近くで　見てみましょう。

key: TAKA: I don't think I can read this, but I definitely recognize it.
en: TAKA: I don't think I can read this, but I definitely recognize it.
ja: タカ: 読めそうには　ないですけど　これ　確かに　見覚えが　あります。

key: Why...?
en: Why...?
ja: なんでだろう……?

key: TAKA: I was here before...
en: TAKA: I was here before...
ja: タカ: 前にも　ここに　来たことが……

key: This statue wasn't broken then.
en: This statue wasn't broken then.
ja: あのときは　この像　壊れて　いませんでした。

key: How long ago was it...?
en: How long ago was it...?
ja: どれくらい前だったかな……?

key: TAKA: I can't even read this... What's the point?
en: TAKA: I can't even read this... What's the point?
ja: タカ: これ　読めもしませんし……　意味　あるんでしょうか?

key: Sugiline Cave stairs being unlocked has been detected from a different save file.
en: Sugiline Cave stairs being unlocked has been detected from a different save file.
ja: 別のセーブデータで　スギラインどうくつの　階段が　解放された記録が　見つかった。

key: Unlock stairs on this file?
en: Unlock stairs on this file?
ja: このセーブデータでも　階段を　解放しますか?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
